## 어떤 장면을 만들고 싶나 / What scene do you want

## 지금 도구로 해 보면 / What happens with today's tools

어떤 도구를 써 봤고 무엇이 모자랐나요 (도구 목록: README "도구" 절, 예시: docs/recipes.md).
Which tools did you try and what was missing (tool list in the README, examples in docs/recipes.md).

## 참고 자료 / References

Links to similar shots, or the manual Blender steps if you know them.
